AdminDataRows.description:
The `GET /v1/admin/{resource}` rows payload: the per-resource row
documents the RFW DataTable renders (row cells and per-resource
column sets are service-defined; the RFW renderer reads them
dynamically).

AdminUiAction.description: An action button shown in the page header.

route.description: Route to navigate to (for link actions).

AdminUiActionType.description: The kind of a header action button.

oneOf.description: Redirect to this route (e.g. after a successful form submission).

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

CallbackConfig.description:
Callback config for proxy-back host functions (from the execute request).

`host_functions` maps each WASM-imported host-function name to the path
template on the calling service's internal API (e.g.
`ledger_get_balance` → `/accounts/{args.0}/balance`). Func resolves these
dynamically at execute time - it does **not** pre-register any
service-specific host functions.
Configuration for callback.

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

ExecuteRequest.description:
`POST /v1/modules/{id}/execute` request body.
Request body for execute.

idempotency_key.description:
Optional idempotency key (principles §4.14 - every trigger
dedupes on the event's key): a replayed execution with the same
key returns the cached response instead of re-running the hook.
The idempotency key.

ExecuteResponse.description:
`POST /v1/modules/{id}/execute` response body.
Response payload for execute.

LiveHealth.description:
The `GET /v1/health` liveness payload every service returns: the
status string, the serving service's short name, build identity, and
(when the process tracks them) the count of live connections.
`service` and `active_connections` stay absent when a service does
not set them (e.g. the bus mounts the generic handler).

active_connections.description: Live socket count when the traffic counter is mounted.

service.description:
The serving service's short name (absent when the generic handler
does not carry one).
